after_lurker.text: The light is steadier. Thank you. But listen: the well is still answering something below us. Will you help me trace that note?

answer_found.text: Three notes in the reeds, and the same three under the gate? That is no storm. Someone built this place to listen. I will find the old plans before we open anything. Take these chits for your trouble.

explain_note.text: Sunthread holds a sound after the wind leaves it. Listen there first, then at the cistern gate. Leave the gate sealed and bring me what you hear.

explain_well.text: It keeps this reef steady when the Glimmerdeep storms turn restless.

first_task.text: The creature has settled east of the well. Watch what it prepares before you cast. The reeds can wait until you are safe.

greeting.text: You feel that dim pulse under your boots? The well is asking for help.

listening.text: Listen to the reeds, then the sealed cistern. I need to know whether the two are answering each other. Come back when you have heard both.

saltglass_cistern.text: Beyond the sealed stone, the same three notes return in reverse. A narrow line of light wakes in an old hinge, then fades. You leave the gate closed. Mara should hear about this.
saltglass_cistern.title: An answer beneath the gate

sunthread_reeds.text: You let the reeds settle. Three low notes remain after the wind fades; the last seems to pull toward the sealed cistern. Nothing here needs to be harvested.
sunthread_reeds.title: A note held in sunthread
